 ORDER With the consent of learned counsel for the parties, heard finally at motion stage.

This miscellaneous appeal has been filed by the appellant under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act,
1988, being aggrieved by award dated 19.12.2022 passed by Member XXIII Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur in MACC No. 5133/2019 seeking enhancement of compensation amount.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that tribunal has determined appellant's monthly income as Rs.7,000/- per month whereas on the date of accident, minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.7,950/-.
Therefore, appellant's income should have been determined accordingly.
It is also urged that Tribunal has assessed only 20% permanent disability whereas in view nature of job of appellant, at least 40% permanent disability should have been assessed.
On above grounds, it is urged that compensation awarded by tribunal be suitably enhanced.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent No.3 has submitted that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper.
Hence, no enhancement is required.
Therefore, appeal filed by the appellant be dismissed.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
5.
So far as income of appellant is concerned, on the date of accident minimum wages of an unskilled labour were Rs.7,950/-.

Hence, appellant's monthly income is determined as Rs.7,950/-
per month.

6. So far as functional disability/ loss of future earning is concerned, Tribunal has determined appellant's monthly income as treating him an unskilled labour.

Therefore, in view of nature/profession of appellant and nature of injury/permanent disability, as disclosed in deposition of applicant witness Dr.Sanjay Jain, in this Court's considered opinion, it would be just and proper to determine functional disability/loss of future earning capacity as 30%.
8. Further, perusal of para 42 of impugned award reveal that tribunal has not awarded any amount for loss of amenities.
Appellant is also entitled to receive appropriate compensation under the head of loss of amenities.
